description.value:
Make a melee Strike with yourself against a foe. In addition to the Strike's normal effects, for up to 1 minute (ending early if the foe dies or at the end of any turn in which you didn't hit that foe with a melee Strike):

Critical Success +3 status bonus to AC against the foe for 1 round, then +2 until the effect ends.

Success +2 status bonus to AC against the foe until the effect ends.

Failure +1 status bonus to AC against the foe until the effect ends.

Critical Failure No additional effect.
